query: SELECT python_minor, if(endsWith(filename, '.whl'), arrayElement(splitByChar('-', substring(filename, 1, greatest(length(filename) - 4, 0))), -3), '') AS interp, if(endsWith(filename, '.whl'), arrayElement(splitByChar('-', substring(filename, 1, greatest(length(filename) - 4, 0))), -2), '') AS abi, if(endsWith(filename, '.whl'), arrayElement(splitByChar('-', substring(filename, 1, greatest(length(filename) - 4, 0))), -1), if(filename = '', '(no file name)', '(not a wheel)')) AS plat, count() AS n FROM pypi.pypi WHERE project = 'aiohttp' AND date IN ('2026-09-21','2026-09-22','2026-09-23','2026-09-24','2026-09-25','2026-09-26','2026-09-27') AND version NOT IN ('3.14.3','4.0.0a0','4.0.0a1') GROUP BY python_minor, interp, abi, plat FORMAT CSVWithNames
